# Merrimack Smiles

> A comprehensive family dental practice in Merrimack, NH offering preventative, pediatric, and restorative dental care with a patient-centered approach.

Merrimack Smiles is a trusted dental practice serving the Merrimack, New Hampshire community with a team of experienced dentists including Dr. Mark S. Morris and Dr. Catherine G. Cagino. The practice specializes in family dentistry, preventative care, and pediatric services with a focus on patient education and oral health.

## Key Topics

- Family Dentistry
- Preventative Care
- Pediatric Dental Care
- Restorative Dentistry
- Cavity Prevention

- Custom Mouthguards
- Fluoride Treatment
- Merrimack, NH
- Patient Education
- Appointment Booking
- Dental Hygiene
- Children's Dentistry

## Pediatric Dental Care

- [Pediatric Dental Care | Merrimack Smiles | Trusted Children's Dentist](https://merrimacksmiles.com/services/pediatric-dental-care): Pediatric dental care service page for preventative and restorative children's dentistry.
- [Routine Pediatric Dental Cleanings | Merrimack Smiles | Dentist](https://merrimacksmiles.com/services/pediatric-dental-care/routine-pediatric-dental-cleanings): Routine pediatric dental cleanings and preventative care for children's oral health.
- [Dental Sealants for Kids & Adults | Prevent Cavities](https://merrimacksmiles.com/services/pediatric-dental-care/dental-sealants): Dental sealants service for cavity prevention in children and adults.
- [Silver Diamine Fluoride | Stop Tooth Decay](https://merrimacksmiles.com/services/pediatric-dental-care/silver-diamine-fluoride): Silver Diamine Fluoride non-invasive treatment for tooth decay in kids and adults.
- [Pediatric Dental Crown | Merrimack Smiles](https://merrimacksmiles.com/services/pediatric-dental-care/pediatric-dental-crown): Pediatric dental crowns for tooth restoration and protection in children.
- [Pulpotomy | Expert Dental Care in Merrimack NH](https://merrimacksmiles.com/services/pediatric-dental-care/pulpotomy): Pulpotomy endodontic procedure for baby teeth restoration and pain relief.

## Protective & Specialty Care

- [Athletic Mouthguard | Protect Your Smile](https://merrimacksmiles.com/services/preventative-family-dental-care/athletic-mouthguard): Custom athletic mouthguard service for sports protection and dental safety.
- [Night Mouthguards | Teeth Grinding Relief](https://merrimacksmiles.com/services/preventative-family-dental-care/night-mouthguards): Custom night mouthguards for bruxism, teeth grinding, and TMJ relief.
- [Dental Space Maintainers for Children | Merrimack Smiles](https://merrimacksmiles.com/services/pediatric-dental-care/dental-space-maintainer): Dental space maintainers for children to prevent misalignment and tooth eruption issues.
